fields.gap: No reliable row in Wagner 2020 Table 3 reaches lambda near 65-68. Krenzke's 0.11-0.90 range mixes R/t 10-212 and stiffened with unstiffened machined shells, so 0.90 may be a thick or stiffened specimen. Adam and King, reliable yes, reach 0.89 only to lambda 43.11.
fields.direction: Separate the Krenzke upper by R/t and by stiffened versus unstiffened.
fields.effect: The carried 0.90 is an upper end of the tabulated reliable set, not a measurement at this slenderness.
